data.narrative:
CreateMe operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. While eleven same-sector peers exist, the dataset identifies zero companies meeting narrow stage-alignment or valuation-tier criteria necessary for reliable peer-median triangulation.

The peer-median method is not applicable. Filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers within Robotics & Manufacturing yielded insufficient datapoints—below the three-company minimum required for statistical confidence. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial comparability noise and is therefore rejected.

Given the constraints, traditional valuation methods cannot be reliably supported by the available data. A defensible valuation requires either: narrowing the focus to the identified private peer set with disclosure of stage-specific metrics (revenue, growth rate, capital efficiency), benchmarking against the single public comparable with explicit adjustments for stage and market conditions, or obtaining additional transaction data from recent financings within CreateMe's cohort. Without quantitative inputs on CreateMe's revenue, burn rate, or capital efficiency, or stage-specific valuations from the peer set, no triangulated range can be supported.
